items.title: llm 0.37
items.snippet: Release: llm 0.37 There's a lot of stuff in this new release of my LLM CLI tool and Python library, representing around two months of accumulated features and fixes. I added gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra , plus a new llm openai endpoint add command to make it easier to configure additional models that use OpenAI-compatible endpoints. I switched the default model (if you have not set your own default) to gpt-6-luna - half the price of the previous default, gpt-5.6-luna . LLM's support for embeddi
items.title_ar: إصدار llm 0.37 مع موديلات جديدة وأمر لإضافة endpoints
items.summary_ar: أصدر Simon Willison الإصدار 0.37 من أداة LLM CLI ومكتبة Python، ويتضمن ميزات وإصلاحات تراكمت خلال نحو شهرين. أضاف موديلي gpt-6.1-sol و gpt-6.1-terra، وأمر llm openai endpoint add لتسهيل إعداد موديلات إضافية تعتمد على OpenAI-compatible endpoints. كما أصبح الموديل الافتراضي gpt-6-luna بنصف سعر الافتراضي السابق gpt-5.6-luna.
items.why_ar: أداة سريعة لتجربة موديلات جديدة وربط endpoints متوافقة مع OpenAI في POC دون كتابة كود مخصص.
items.title_en: llm 0.37 adds new GPT models and an endpoint add command
items.summary_en: Simon Willison released llm 0.37, an update to his LLM CLI tool and Python library covering about two months of features and fixes. It adds gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra, plus a new llm openai endpoint add command for OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The default model switches to gpt-6-luna, which is half the price of the previous default gpt-5.6-luna.
items.why_en: It offers a quick way to test new models and wire up OpenAI-compatible endpoints in a POC without custom code.

items.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
items.snippet: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
items.title_ar: Anthropic تحذر من قرب الوصول إلى RSI
items.summary_ar: تحذر Anthropic من أنها أصبحت قريبة جداً من قدرة RSI، أي أن يبني الذكاء الاصطناعي نفسه. يوصف RSI بأنه النقطة التي يصبح فيها النموذج بارعاً في تدريب نفسه، مما يسرّع تطور القدرات بشكل كبير.
items.why_ar: يهم هذا المهندس لأن فهم تقنيات التدريب الذاتي ومخاطرها يؤثر على تصميم الأنظمة وسياسات الاستخدام الداخلية.
items.title_en: Anthropic Warns It Is Very Close to RSI Capability
items.summary_en: Anthropic warns that it is very close to RSI capability, meaning AI that builds itself. RSI is described as the point where AI becomes so good at training itself that its capabilities accelerate dramatically.
items.why_en: It is relevant for understanding self-improving training methods and the risk considerations that shape how such systems are designed and deployed.

items.title: ctoldigital/axuse
items.snippet: Accessibility-first browser & computer use for AI agents — one MCP server for every harness (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity). Instruments the DOM/accessibility tree via CDP instead of screenshot loops: diffed snapshots, stable element refs, trusted input, typed errors. Zero dependencies
items.title_ar: axuse: تحكم موثوق بالمتصفح والحاسوب لوكلاء AI عبر MCP
items.summary_ar: خادم MCP واحد يخدم agents متعددة مثل Codex وClaude Code وOpenCode وAntigravity. يعتمد على شجرة accessibility في DOM عبر CDP بدلاً من حلقات screenshot، ويوفر snapshots متغيرة ومراجع عناصر ثابتة وإدخالاً موثوقاً وأخطاء typed، مع وصفه بأنه بلا dependencies.
items.why_ar: يفيد في بناء agents تتعامل مع واجهات الويب بموثوقية أعلى من الاعتماد على لقطات الشاشة.
items.title_en: axuse: accessibility-first browser control for AI agents via MCP
items.summary_en: A single MCP server that serves multiple agent harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Antigravity. It instruments the DOM accessibility tree through CDP instead of screenshot loops, offering diffed snapshots, stable element refs, trusted input, and typed errors, and is described as having zero dependencies.
items.why_en: It is worth testing for building agents that interact with web interfaces more reliably than screenshot-based approaches.

items.title: Goldman bans traders and bankers from using AI coding tools
items.snippet: Goldman Sachs has banned traders and other employees from using advanced AI tools for coding over productivity and risk concerns, according to Bloomberg
items.title_ar: Goldman Sachs تمنع استخدام أدوات AI للبرمجة لدى موظفيها
items.summary_ar: أفادت Bloomberg بأن Goldman Sachs منعت المتداولين والموظفين الآخرين من استخدام أدوات AI المتقدمة للبرمجة. السبب المذكور هو مخاوف تتعلق بالإنتاجية والمخاطر. يعكس القرار حذراً مؤسسياً تجاه أدوات coding assistants في البيئات المالية.
items.why_ar: يفيدك كمهندس في بنك لأنه يوضح قيود الحوكمة التي قد تواجه أي أداة برمجة AI تريد تبنيها داخل المؤسسة.
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs bans traders and bankers from AI coding tools
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that Goldman Sachs has banned traders and other employees from using advanced AI tools for coding. The stated reasons are concerns about productivity and risk. The decision reflects institutional caution toward coding assistants in financial environments.
items.why_en: As a bank AI engineer, this shows the governance constraints any coding AI tool must pass before adoption inside your organization.

items.title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
items.snippet: Google's Dreambeans, its latest AI experiment, now supports 13 Indian languages.
items.title_ar: Google تطلق Dreambeans في الهند بدعم 13 لغة هندية
items.summary_ar: Dreambeans هي تجربة AI جديدة من Google تنشئ قصصاً شخصية مولّدة بالذكاء الاصطناعي. الأداة تدعم الآن 13 لغة هندية، في محاولة للوصول إلى جمهور أوسع في الهند.
items.why_ar: تكشف كيف تتعامل منتجات AI الاستهلاكية مع توليد المحتوى بعدة لغات، وهو مرجع مفيد لأي POC يحتاج إلى تعدد لغات.
items.title_en: Google takes Dreambeans to India with support for 13 Indian languages
items.summary_en: Dreambeans is Google's latest AI experiment for generating personal stories. It now supports 13 Indian languages as Google pushes it toward a wider audience in India.
items.why_en: It shows how a consumer AI product handles multilingual generation, a useful reference for localization work in a POC.

items.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
items.snippet: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
items.title_ar: Garry Tan يصرف حتى 200 ألف دولار سنوياً على tokens لاستخدام AI agents
items.summary_ar: قال Garry Tan من Y Combinator في بودكاست The Builders إنه يستخدم AI agents بكثافة حتى إنه ينفق حتى 200 ألف دولار سنوياً على tokens. ووصف حماسه مازحاً بأنه cyber psychosis، وذكر أنه ينام قليلاً أحياناً.
items.why_ar: يعطي رقماً واقعياً لتكلفة الاستخدام المكثف للـ agents، وهو مهم عند تقدير ميزانية الـ tokens في POCs.
items.title_en: Garry Tan spends up to $200K a year on tokens for AI agents
items.summary_en: Garry Tan of Y Combinator said on Walter Isaacson's podcast The Builders that he uses AI agents so heavily he spends up to $200K a year on tokens. He jokingly described his excitement as cyber psychosis and said he sometimes barely sleeps.
items.why_en: It gives a concrete data point on the real token cost of heavy agent usage, useful when budgeting POCs.

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.snippet: Robot agents built on vision-language models depend on both the planner and its harness: the tools, feedback, memory, and recovery logic around it. Can improvements to a large teacher's harness be carried into a compact agent with lower inference compute cost? We present TinyAstral, a two-stage approach. We first freeze an open-weight teacher and improve its harness through recursive self-improvement (RSI): frontier LLM agents read the teacher's trajectories and propose harness edits, and each edit is accepted only if it passes a paired statistical test. We then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories with reasoning and failure recovery, and distill a small student that replac
items.title_ar: TinyAstral: نقل harness ذاتي التطور إلى وكلاء روبوتات صغيرة
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة أن أداء وكلاء الروبوتات المبنية على vision-language models يعتمد على المخطط وعلى harness المحيط به. يعتمد النهج على مرحلتين: تحسين harness لمعلم كبير عبر RSI مع قبول التعديلات بعد اختبار إحصائي، ثم تقطير الخبرة إلى student صغير.
items.why_ar: تستحق الفكرة التجربة لأنها تقدم طريقة لتقليل تكلفة inference في وكلاء الروبوتات دون تدريب كامل من الصفر.
items.title_en: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Robot Agents
items.summary_en: The paper argues that robot agents built on vision-language models depend on both the planner and its harness. TinyAstral improves a frozen teacher's harness through RSI with statistically tested edits, then distills a small student that replaces it while keeping reasoning and recovery behavior.
items.why_en: It offers a practical distillation approach worth testing if you want a compact agent with lower inference cost.

items.title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
items.snippet: Embedding models underpin virtually every modern AI system, from search engines to recommendation systems. Despite shared mathematical foundations, research on embedding models remains fragmented by modality: the communities develop largely in isolation, seldom exchanging insights. We argue that this fragmentation obscures a deeper convergence. Driven by contrastive learning, Transformer architectures, and a granularity shift, embedding research across modalities is converging toward a common set of principles, even as modality-specific challenges remain underexplored. To reason across this convergence without conflating it, we propose a framework of three progressively harder capabilities:
items.title_ar: مسح ومخطط طريق لـ Omnimodal Embeddings
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة مسحاً لأبحاث embeddings التي تطورت بشكل منفصل حسب الوسيط. تجادل بأن هذه الأبحاث تتقارب نحو مبادئ مشتركة بفضل contrastive learning وTransformer وتحول نحو granularity. تقترح إطاراً من ثلاث قدرات تتدرج في الصعوبة.
items.why_ar: تصلح هذه الورقة كمرجع لموضوع بحثي أو لاختيار embeddings في أنظمة multimodal تحتاج فهماً مشتركاً للنصوص والصور والصوت.
items.title_en: From Fragmentation to Fusion: Omnimodal Embeddings Survey and Roadmap
items.summary_en: The paper surveys embedding research, which has developed in isolation across modalities. It argues that contrastive learning, Transformer architectures, and a granularity shift are pushing these fields toward shared principles. It proposes a framework of three progressively harder capabilities.
items.why_en: It serves as a useful reference for a research write-up or for choosing embedding approaches in multimodal systems.

items.title: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards: Learning from Verified Traces and Evaluating Transfer
items.snippet: Answer-level rewards cannot distinguish reasoning traces with equally correct outcomes. We study whether auxiliary trajectory preferences improve small-language-model self-improvement and transfer under limited supervision. We compare confidence-based (SC) and entropy-based metrics (UID-Conj.), which combines global entropy variation and local smoothness, through online reward augmentation and offline training on correct responses. Online experiments adapt Qwen3-1.7B on 30 AIME problems without reference answers; offline experiments use historical AIME problems. UID-Conj. improves the online macro-average across the adaptation benchmark and three transfer benchmarks by 2.08 percentage points
items.title_ar: تحسين النموذج الذاتي بمكافآت مساعدة من traces موثقة
items.summary_ar: الورقة تبيّن أن الـ rewards المبنية على الإجابة النهائية فقط لا تميّز بين reasoning traces صحيحة النتيجة لكنها مختلفة في الجودة. تقارن بين مقياس confidence-based (SC) ومقياس entropy-based باسم UID-Conj. عبر online reward augmentation وoffline training على الإجابات الصحيحة، وتجارب على Qwen3-1.7B على 30 مسألة AIME. يحسن UID-Conj. المتوسط العام بنحو 2.08 percentage points عبر benchmark التكيّف وثلاثة transfer benchmarks.
items.why_ar: تقنية قابلة للتجربة في تحسين small language models بدون supervision كثيف، وقد تصلح كفكرة POC لتدريب موديلات صغيرة داخلياً.
items.title_en: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards from Verified Reasoning Traces
items.summary_en: The paper shows that answer-level rewards cannot distinguish reasoning traces that reach the same correct outcome. It compares a confidence-based metric (SC) with an entropy-based metric (UID-Conj.) through online reward augmentation and offline training on correct responses. Experiments adapt Qwen3-1.7B on 30 AIME problems without reference answers, and UID-Conj. improves the online macro-average by 2.08 percentage points across the adaptation and three transfer benchmarks.
items.why_en: It is a technique worth testing for improving small models under limited supervision, and could inspire a POC for internal model fine-tuning.

items.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
items.snippet: Decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. However, transferring a generative LLM's ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging: the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document ID sequences, while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. To bridge this gap, we introduce DecisionRank, a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distillation (OPD). Item-space OPD constructs the student's rollout by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence. A generative teacher takes the resulting ranking list as inputs and provides conditio
items.title_ar: DecisionRank: تقطير on-policy لمعيدي ترتيب decision models
items.summary_ar: Decision models تتنبأ مباشرة بالاختيارات أو الدرجات دون autoregressive decoding، مما يقلل latency. تقدم الورقة DecisionRank وهو decision model يُدرَّب عبر item-space on-policy distillation، حيث يرتب الطالب مستنداته بحسب درجاته ثم يمرر الترتيب إلى generative teacher لتوفير إشارات تدريب. الهدف نقل معرفة الترتيب من LLM توليدي إلى نموذج قرار سريع.
items.why_ar: فكرة مفيدة لبناء reranker سريع في أنظمة RAG داخلية حيث latency مهم.
items.title_en: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Fast Decision-Model Rerankers
items.summary_en: Decision models predict choices or scores directly, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. The paper introduces DecisionRank, trained through item-space on-policy distillation, where the student sorts its document scores into a ranked sequence that a generative teacher evaluates. The goal is to transfer a generative LLM's ranking knowledge into a faster decision model.
items.why_en: It offers a practical idea for building a low-latency reranker in RAG pipelines, a likely POC for internal document search.

items.title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
items.snippet: Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this gap. We introduce ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks in which the scene, question, and answer are fixed and only the reference varies. Results show that task-matched referenc
items.title_ar: تشخيص فجوة المرجع: ما تستطيع الـ visual scaffolds إصلاحه في multimodal reasoning
items.summary_ar: تستطيع multimodal LLMs التعرف على المحتوى البصري لكنها تفقد التتبع عبر خطوات متعددة، مثل تتبع العناصر المعدودة. تقترح الورقة أن هذا يعود إلى reference gap أي عدم ربط اللغة بالكيانات البصرية الصحيحة، وتختبر أثر references خارجية كالترقيم. تقدم ReGap-Bench وهو benchmark مزدوج من خمس مهام بصرية يتغير فيه المرجع فقط.
items.why_ar: يفيد أي مهندس يبني أنظمة vision-language، ويمكن تجربته في استخراج المستندات أو الصور المالية.
items.title_en: Diagnosing the Reference Gap in Multimodal Reasoning
items.summary_en: Multimodal LLMs can recognize visual content yet fail to reason reliably over multiple steps, such as keeping track of counted objects. The paper argues this is a reference gap in binding language to visual entities and tests whether external references like numbering help. It introduces ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks where only the reference changes.
items.why_en: It offers a practical prompting technique for vision-language POCs, such as document or image understanding tasks.

items.title: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Systems with Hierarchical Collaboration Workloads
items.snippet: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate specialized agents to solve complex tasks, turning each user request into interdependent model and tool operations. Unlike independent requests, these operations become ready at different times and consume evolving context as agents coordinate and exchange results. This creates changing patterns of concurrency, computation, and memory demand that can expose different bottlenecks in LLM serving hardware. Yet benchmarking these effects requires capturing the collaboration rules that generate serving workloads, beyond the requests observed during execution. We present MAServeBench, a benchmark that treats multi-agent collabor
items.title_ar: MAServeBench: قياس أداء serving لأنظمة multi-agent LLM
items.summary_ar: أنظمة multi-agent تنسق وكلاء متخصصين لحل مهام معقدة، فيتحول كل طلب إلى عمليات model وtool مترابطة. هذا يخلق أنماط concurrency وmemory متغيرة قد تكشف عن اختناقات في hardware الخاص بالـ LLM serving. تقدم الورقة MAServeBench وهو benchmark يلتقط قواعد التعاون التي تولد أحمال العمل.
items.why_ar: مفيد عند تخطيط بنية إنتاجية لأنظمة agents، خاصة لتقدير الـ latency والـ GPU من الآن.
items.title_en: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Serving Systems for Multi-Agent LLMs
items.summary_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems turn each request into interdependent model and tool operations that become ready at different times. This creates changing concurrency and memory demand that can expose serving bottlenecks. The paper presents MAServeBench, which captures collaboration rules that generate serving workloads.
items.why_en: It is useful for planning production infrastructure for agent systems, especially for estimating latency and GPU capacity.

items.title: N1nEmAn/sapper-v2
items.snippet: Autonomous pentest legion — AI commander + worker swarm + layered fact-intent graph. 3rd Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online champion (634 teams · 8h unattended · 1B tokens beat 4.5B). The Nüwa Test: give AIs Create/Language/History, let a civilization grow.
items.title_ar: sapper-v2: سرب agents مستقل لاختبار الاختراق الآلي
items.summary_ar: ريبو GitHub يقدم pentest legion مستقلاً يجمع AI commander مع worker swarm وlayered fact-intent graph. وفق الوصف، حصد الفريق المركز الثالث في Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense بين 634 فريقاً، وعمل 8 ساعات دون تدخل باستخدام 1B tokens متفوقاً على منافس استخدم 4.5B tokens.
items.why_ar: فكرة مفيدة لبناء POC في الأمن السيبراني البنكي تعتمد على agents متعددة للتعامل مع مهام الاختبار الأمني.
items.title_en: sapper-v2: autonomous pentest agent swarm
items.summary_en: A GitHub repo presenting an autonomous pentest legion that combines an AI commander, a worker swarm, and a layered fact-intent graph. According to its description, it placed third in the Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online championship among 634 teams, running 8 hours unattended on 1B tokens and beating a 4.5B-token entry.
items.why_en: It is a useful POC idea for banking security testing that relies on multi-agent orchestration.

items.title: eliasbiondo/antirion
items.snippet: 🕷️ The fastest open-source AI Gateway and LLM Gateway — one binary with built-in console to route, secure, budget and observe every LLM call across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock and more.
items.title_ar: antirion: بوابة LLM Gateway سريعة ومفتوحة المصدر
items.summary_ar: بوابة open-source لـ LLM Gateway تأتي كملف binary واحد مع console مدمج. تتيح توجيه كل استدعاء LLM وتأمينه وتحديد ميزانيته ومراقبته عبر OpenAI وAnthropic وGemini وBedrock وغيرها.
items.why_ar: مفيدة لتوحيد الوصول إلى عدة موديلات وضبط التكلفة والمراقبة داخل البيئة البنكية.
items.title_en: antirion: fast open-source LLM gateway with built-in console
items.summary_en: An open-source AI and LLM gateway shipped as a single binary with a built-in console. It routes, secures, budgets, and observes every LLM call across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, and more providers.
items.why_en: It helps standardize access to multiple models while controlling spend and observability inside a bank.

items.title: يحذر البنك المركزي الأوروبي من المخاطر عندما تكون أسهم الذكاء الاصطناعي مبالغًا في تقييمها. - Vietnam.vn
items.snippet: يحذر البنك المركزي الأوروبي من المخاطر عندما تكون أسهم الذكاء الاصطناعي مبالغًا في تقييمها. Vietnam.vn
items.title_ar: البنك المركزي الأوروبي يحذر من مخاطر تقييم أسهم AI المبالغ فيه
items.summary_ar: يحذر البنك المركزي الأوروبي من مخاطر محتملة عندما تكون أسهم AI مبالغاً في تقييمها. يعكس التحذير قلقاً من تكرار دورات المضاربة المالية المرتبطة بتقنيات جديدة. النص المتاح عنوان مختصر دون تفاصيل إضافية.
items.why_ar: يفيدك هذا الخبر لفهم نظرة الرقابة المالية إلى موجة AI قبل تقديم أي POC يخص الاستثمار أو إدارة المخاطر.
items.title_en: ECB warns of risks as AI stocks look overvalued
items.summary_en: The European Central Bank warns of potential risks when AI stocks are overvalued. The warning reflects concern about speculative cycles tied to new technologies. The source text is a brief headline with no further detail.
items.why_en: It helps you understand how financial regulators view the AI boom before proposing any POC involving investment or risk management.

items.title: Conversations on Central Banking: Macroeconomy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence - Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland
items.snippet: Conversations on Central Banking: Macroeconomy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland
items.title_ar: Macroeconomy in the Age of AI: محادثة من Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland
items.summary_ar: نشر Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland محادثة ضمن سلسلة Conversations on Central Banking بعنوان Macroeconomy in the Age of AI. تتناول المحادثة على ما يبدو أثر AI على الاقتصاد الكلي. النص المتاح عنوان فقط دون ملخص تفصيلي.

items.title_en: Macroeconomy in the Age of AI: Cleveland Fed conversation
items.summary_en: The Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland published a conversation in its Conversations on Central Banking series titled Macroeconomy in the Age of AI. It appears to address the impact of AI on the macroeconomy. The source text is only a title with no detailed summary.
items.why_en: It serves as an initial reference for a research paper on AI's macroeconomic impact and monetary policy.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.snippet: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation ch
items.title_ar: توليد الفيديو يلتقي بـ agent harness: توليد وكيلي ونمذجة عوالم
items.summary_ar: تتحول توليد الفيديو من synthesis مباشر إلى agentic generation يعتمد على planning وtool use وfeedback. يدرس التقرير agent harness كبيئة تنفيذ تدير context وtools وstate وbudgets حول video models. يناقش ثلاثة اتجاهات تشمل توليد الفيديو الوكيلي ونمذجة العوالم الوكيلية وrecursive self-improvement.
items.why_ar: مرجع مفيد لفهم كيف تُبنى أنظمة agent حول موديلات الفيديو، وإن كان بعيداً عن الاستخدام البنكي المباشر.
items.title_en: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video and World Modeling
items.summary_en: Video generation is moving toward agentic workflows with planning, tool use, and feedback for controllable multi-shot videos. The report studies the agent harness, an executable runtime that manages context, tools, state, and budgets around video models. It examines agentic video generation, agentic world modeling, and recursive self-improvement.
items.why_en: It is a useful architectural reference for agent harness design, though it is less directly relevant to banking use cases.

items.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
items.snippet: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and conte
items.title_ar: On-Policy Self-Distillation مع تطور المعلم
items.summary_ar: تحاول OPSD محاذاة توزيع الـ token للطالب مع توزيع الـ self-teacher المعزز بسياق مميز، لتخفيف reward sparsity. لكن الأداء لا يتحسن باستمرار، والسبب أن قدرة النموذج على التعليم الذاتي محدودة وتولد إرشادات غير موثوقة. تقترح الورقة TESD حيث يولد المعلم rollouts ويتلقى feedback من البيئة بناء على صحة المهمة.
items.why_ar: تقنية post-training قد تفيد في تحسين موديلات داخلية، وتستحق المتابعة إذا كنت تعمل على RL أو fine-tuning.
items.title_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
items.summary_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation aligns a student's token distribution with a self-teacher prompted with privileged context, to reduce reward sparsity. The paper finds that limited self-teaching ability produces unreliable guidance and stalls gains. It proposes TESD, where the self-teacher generates rollouts and receives environment feedback based on task correctness.
items.why_en: It is a post-training technique worth testing if you work on RL or fine-tuning pipelines.
